title: Product Character on a Single Coordinate
statement: For every positive integer $m$, every natural number $n$, every function $\alpha:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$, every index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and every residue $y$ modulo $m$, the product character indexed by $\alpha$, evaluated on the vector equal to $y$ at coordinate $i$ and zero elsewhere, equals $\chi_{\alpha(i)}(y)$, where $\chi_j$ denotes the cyclic character indexed by $j$.
